name: Enzyme Substrate Genetic Context (Full Descendant Control)
plain_language_rule: Predict treatment when The candidate drug independently affects the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; The disease-associated enzyme has the candidate drug as a substrate The pinned descendant closure is biolink:has_substrate. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.; The enzyme is genetically associated with the disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:gene_associated_with_condition. At least one primary source must be infores:geneticskp. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.
hypothesis: A disease-linked enzyme substrate may provide metabolic intervention or replacement context.

edges.subject: chemical
edges.explanation: The candidate drug independently affects the same disease The pinned descendant closure is biolink:affects, biolink:affects_response_to, biolink:ameliorates_condition, biolink:decreases_response_to, biolink:disrupts, biolink:exacerbates_condition, biolink:has_adverse_event, biolink:has_side_effect, biolink:increases_response_to, biolink:regulates. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.

edges.subject: gene
edges.explanation: The disease-associated enzyme has the candidate drug as a substrate The pinned descendant closure is biolink:has_substrate. At least one primary source must be infores:chembl. No predicate descendants are excluded in this control.

edges.subject: gene

mechanism.rationale: A disease-linked enzyme substrate may provide metabolic intervention or replacement context. The graph pattern is a hypothesis, not proof of clinical efficacy.

execution.cypher_template: MATCH (chemical:Drug)-[direct:{{relationship_types:direct}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE direct.predicate IN {{predicates:direct}} MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[substrate:{{relationship_types:substrate}}]->(chemical:Drug) WHERE substrate.predicate IN {{predicates:substrate}} AND any(source IN ["infores:chembl"] WHERE source IN coalesce(substrate.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) MATCH (gene:GeneOrGeneProduct)-[association:{{relationship_types:association}}]->(disease:Disease) WHERE association.predicate IN {{predicates:association}} AND any(source IN ["infores:geneticskp"] WHERE source IN coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources,[])) RETURN chemical.id AS subject_id,disease.id AS object_id,count(DISTINCT gene) AS support_count

trapi.limitations: Outside TRAPI: substrate: enforce primary-source membership in infores:chembl; association: enforce primary-source membership in infores:geneticskp

limitations: Unknown predictions are unlabeled, not known negatives.
Canonical graph identifiers are deduplicated; parallel evidence does not multiply gene support.
Metabolic processing can affect drug exposure without treating the enzyme-linked disease; this is an association diagnostic.
The full affects closure includes ameliorates_condition and is classified as treatment-using even if no such edge satisfies the other constraints in this graph.
